bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
tmp="$(mktemp -d)";trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/old.py"
git show db27cab03e08c435c056f72d960a67e183c0f48f:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py > "$tmp/new.py"
python3 - "$tmp/old.py" "$tmp/new.py" "$tmp/updated.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,sys
old=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text();cand=Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text()
start='                                gate_codes = {"ee538b32b74f"'
end='                                await screen.click(text="🔙 戻る")'
assert old.count(start)==1 and cand.count(start)==1
a=old.index(start);b=old.find(end,a)
c=cand.index(start);d=cand.find(end,c)
assert b>a and d>c
updated=old[:a]+cand[c:d]+old[b:]
ast.parse(updated)
Path(sys.argv[3]).write_text(updated)
PY
cp "$tmp/updated.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
chmod 600 scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 3
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
timeout 40s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 72
chat="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py chat_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
invite="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py invite_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
{ echo "FINAL_CHAT_INVITE_LIVE_UI_RESULT"; echo "CHAT=$(printf '%s' "$chat" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)"; echo "INVITE=$(printf '%s' "$invite" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)"; echo "INVITE_ERROR=$(printf '%s' "$invite" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=' | head -1 || echo NONE)"; echo "ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"; echo "ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)"; } | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
printf '%s' "$chat" | grep -q 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS'
printf '%s' "$invite" | grep -q 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS'
